title: WTAgent Reliable Autonomous Development Roadmap
goal: Accept a high-level development goal, decompose it into independently verified tasks, execute and recover safely across workers and conversations, and deliver evidence-backed results.

baseline.evidence: Seven relevant test files: 140 passed, zero failed. Not a Windows/browser soak certification.

relationshipToLegacyPlan: Keep docs/autonomy-tasks.json unchanged. This is the canonical implementation roadmap for the next incremental development cycle, not an automatic authorization to execute privileged actions.

executionPolicy.order: Topological order of dependencies, then array order
executionPolicy.verification: Evidence must come from an independent tool/verifier, never only from model prose. A file hash is not functional proof.
executionPolicy.progress: Mark task IN_PROGRESS before editing, VERIFYING during tests; VERIFIED only after a successful scoped commit. Persist commitSha and test evidence. Do not change completed task statuses without documented remediation.
executionPolicy.recovery: On restart inspect Git HEAD/worktree and this document. If a task was interrupted, reconcile the exact scoped commit and tests before replaying. Do not use git reset/clean, overwrite unrelated changes, or replay uncertain side effects.
executionPolicy.permissions: Local scoped commits are approved. No automatic git push, PR merge, npm publish, global install, live-account interaction, irreversible command, or restart of the currently running Supervisor. Follow existing runtime policy and require appropriate approval.
executionPolicy.release: Versioned packaging/tagging and switching the running instance are separate gated operations. Source edits do not hot-reload into a running Node process.
executionPolicy.failure: Never mark passing solely on changed files. Persist diagnostic code, bound retries, and stop on unknown side effects or exhausted budgets.
executionPolicy.audit: Each task has commitSha, testEvidence, notes. Never stage unrelated files, credentials, browser profiles, or archives.
